title: How Much Protein You Need On A GLP-1
hook: Here's how much protein you need on a GLP-1 so you lose fat and not muscle.
body:
Studies have shown the average person loses a catastrophic amount of muscle on this medication. But you can avoid that by eating enough protein and weight training regularly. I have actually gained muscle and strength on Zepbound. Hitting your protein is harder when you're not hungry, so track your macros. Aim for at least 0.8 grams of protein per pound of lean body mass. In real life, that's a serious serving of protein at lunch and dinner, around 8 ounces each, and protein snacks in between: rotisserie chicken, sardines, jerky, eggs. Your snacks should be protein. Your snacks should not be carbs.

Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor.
close: Leave a comment to let me know how much protein you're getting on your GLP-1.
